tests: [queryselector.test] querySelector Page.$$ should query existing elements without isolation
reason: Puppeteer's `isolate: false` option runs the query in the page's own realm, as a speed setting; its docs say the results are the same. Strider's locators have no such option, so the test's only point is an option Strider doesn't have, and a plain query would pass whatever the engine does

[queryselector.test] querySelector QueryAll $$eval should accept ElementHandles as arguments
[queryselector.test] querySelector QueryAll $$eval should handle many elements
reason: Puppeteer's custom query handlers (`registerCustomQueryHandler`, selectors such as `allArray/div`) run a registered page-side function as a selector engine, as Playwright's `selectors.register` does. Strider has no selector-engine registry, so none of these tests can be written against it
